pagetitle: "Stress test Quarto"

## Stress test Quarto {#stage-start .stress-slide data-stress-stage="start"}

```{=html}
<div class="start-shell">
  <div class="eyebrow">DIAGNOSTICA OFFLINE · CHROMIUM</div>
  <h1>Quanto margine ha questo PC?</h1>
  <p class="lede">Un test progressivo di rendering, animazioni HTML, video, GPU e CPU. Nessuna spiegazione: solo carico misurabile.</p>

  <div class="profile-grid">
    <button class="profile-card" type="button" data-start-profile="quick">
      <span class="profile-time">03:00</span>
      <strong>Test rapido</strong>
      <small>Compatibilità e fluidità</small>
    </button>
    <button class="profile-card profile-card-primary" type="button" data-start-profile="full">
      <span class="profile-time">15:00</span>
      <strong>Test completo</strong>
      <small>Margine e carico sostenuto</small>
    </button>
  </div>

  <label class="fullscreen-choice">
    <input id="fullscreen-choice" type="checkbox" checked>
    Avvia a schermo intero
  </label>

  <div class="safety-note"><kbd>X</kbd> arresto immediato · uscita automatica sotto 15 FPS</div>
</div>
```


## Risultati {#stage-results .stress-slide data-stress-stage="results"}

```{=html}
<div class="results-shell">
  <div id="result-verdict" class="result-verdict" aria-live="polite">
    <span class="verdict-label">RAPPORTO</span>
    <strong>In attesa di un test</strong>
    <small>Avvia un profilo dalla prima slide.</small>
  </div>

  <div id="environment-summary" class="environment-summary"></div>

  <div class="result-table-wrap">
    <table class="result-table">
      <thead><tr><th>Stadio</th><th>FPS</th><th>p95</th><th>Frame persi</th><th>Stato</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody id="result-table-body"><tr><td colspan="5">Nessun dato disponibile</td></tr></tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <div class="result-actions">
    <button type="button" data-export="json" disabled>Scarica JSON</button>
    <button type="button" data-export="csv" disabled>Scarica CSV</button>
    <button type="button" data-start-profile="quick">Ripeti 3 min</button>
    <button type="button" data-start-profile="full">Ripeti 15 min</button>
  </div>
</div>
```
